headline: Inflation Has Wiped Out Wage Growth in Romania, and the Gap With Bucharest Is Widening - Forbes.ro
summary: Inflation has wiped out wage growth in Romania, and the wage gap with Bucharest is widening. The report comes from Forbes Romania.
why: Real wage trends influence consumer spending, household purchasing power and labour costs for employers. Regional wage gaps can shape investment and hiring decisions.
